mapper.sql: r.id, r.title, r.category_id, r.type, r.content_url, r.cover_url, r.source, r.tags, r.course_name, r.teacher, r.school_year, r.term, r.upload_user_id, r.status, r.view_count, r.like_count, r.favorite_count, r.create_time, r.update_time, LEFT(r.description, 150) AS description, u.username AS upload_username, u.nickname AS upload_nickname, u.avatar_url AS upload_avatar, c.name AS category_name

choose.when: AND MATCH(r.title, r.description, r.tags_text) AGAINST (#{query.fulltextKeyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE)

otherwise.if: AND (r.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR r.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR r.tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT
, MATCH(r.title, r.description, r.tags_text) AGAINST (#{query.fulltextKeyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE) AS relevance
FROM resource r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.upload_user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN category c ON r.category_id = c.id
ORDER BY relevance DESC, r.view_count DESC
ORDER BY r.view_count DESC, r.like_count DESC
ORDER BY r.create_time DESC

SELECT
FROM resource r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.upload_user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN category c ON r.category_id = c.id WHERE 1=1
AND r.status = #{status}
AND r.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND (r.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY r.view_count DESC, r.like_count DESC
ORDER BY r.create_time DESC

SELECT r.*, u.username as upload_username, u.nickname as upload_nickname, u.avatar_url as upload_avatar, c.name as category_name FROM resource r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.upload_user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN category c ON r.category_id = c.id WHERE r.id = #{id}

SELECT
FROM resource r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.upload_user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN category c ON r.category_id = c.id WHERE r.status = 1 ORDER BY r.view_count DESC, r.like_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT
FROM resource r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.upload_user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN category c ON r.category_id = c.id WHERE r.upload_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC

SELECT
FROM resource r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.upload_user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN category c ON r.category_id = c.id WHERE r.status = 1 AND (r.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY r.view_count DESC, r.like_count DESC
ORDER BY r.create_time DESC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(like_count), 0) FROM resource WHERE upload_user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1
SELECT DISTINCT r.course_name FROM resource r WHERE r.status = 1 AND r.course_name IS NOT NULL AND r.course_name != '' ORDER BY r.course_name
SELECT DISTINCT r.teacher FROM resource r WHERE r.status = 1 AND r.teacher IS NOT NULL AND r.teacher != '' ORDER BY r.teacher
